description: Explain likely rejection reasons and help dispute incorrect data.
notes: Coded against the Kit contract with a guarded inline fallback shim (window.Kit || ...); the real shared/kit.js landed mid-build and takes precedence — all 10 verified against the real kit: zero console/page errors, core interactions clicked, 1280x800 shot captured.

notes.note: 1 in 5 screening reports has a material error and renters never learn why they were rejected — decoding the report is a genuine unlock at a moment of maximum motivation. $19/dispute for certified-mail filing is priced to the pain. Rejection moments are also inherently viral: people share 'here's why I got rejected' stories.

notes.change: analysis stat cards (.k-kpis) stacked full-width because shared kit.css has no .k-kpis layout rule; added flex row with wrap

notes.note: Report analysis flags material errors; dispute-letter draft OK, zero errors.

notes.change: The 'paste your own report' promise is now real: keyword parser decodes pasted report text into findings + a generated dispute letter (README next-3 #1 lite); demo analyze button marked data-core.
